review.rationale: Coordinator source-grant review on 2026-11-16 retains the exact Design493 AGPL source/licence grant. The real H-22 PostgreSQL failure showed that locking an immutable insert-only identity with FOR SHARE incorrectly demands UPDATE privileges. This bounded successor removes only that unnecessary identity-row lock; protocol/node/hub locks and immutable identity/final-result SQL guards remain. Runtime grants are not broadened. Independent final implementation review and native verification remain required.
